parameters.name: HostShareKeyName
parameters.description: The name of the host shared key to create. Maximum length: 128 characters.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host. 
> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: PassPhrase
parameters.description: The passphrase of the private key (Base64-encoded string).

parameters.name: PrivateKey
parameters.description:
The private key (Base64-encoded string).
> RSA keys and Ed25519 keys generated by using the ssh-keygen command are supported.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host. 
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
